warnings.message: Yarn (Berry): dependenciesMeta takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: Yarn (Berry) has no setting for remote tarball dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: Yarn (Berry) 3.6.4 (yarnPath in .yarnrc.yml) does not support npmMinimalAgeGate (added in 4.10.2), approvedGitRepositories (added in 4.14.0); not written
warnings.fix: Run yarn set version 4.14.0 (or a later release), which saves it in .yarn/releases, points yarnPath in .yarnrc.yml to it and sets packageManager in package.json, then run depcurfew apply again
